coordinateReference: EPSG:4326 WGS84; source coordinates preserved. Camera elevations are not used.
selection: Eight manually curated highway cameras at approaches to Fresno County San Joaquin and Kings River reaches. Boundary-side Madera and Tulare records are explicitly labeled. No distance buffer or viewshed is claimed.
coverageGaps: This first selection has no camera at Friant Dam, James Bypass, Mendota or the upstream gauge sites. No camera field of view is verified as a direct river view.

cameras.name: SR-41 · Avenue 9
cameras.note: North approach to the Fresno–Madera San Joaquin crossing. Camera field of view may face the roadway; river visibility is unverified.

imageReview.method: Visual inspection of publisher image in browser; not an automated availability detector. Recheck after conditions change.
